dz: 法国和印第安人战争：在战争的第一次交战中，22 岁的乔治·华盛顿中校领导的弗吉尼亚民兵在朱蒙维尔格伦战役（位于现宾夕法尼亚州西南部的费耶特县）击败了一支法国侦察队。
de: French and Indian War: In the first engagement of the war, Virginia militia under the 22-year-old Lieutenant colonel George Washington defeat a French reconnaissance party in the Battle of Jumonville Glen in what is now Fayette County in southwestern Pennsylvania.
